title: Profitable Sports Facility for Sale in Abu Dhabi, UAE
tagline: Premier skating academy based in Abu Dhabi and Dubai, specializing in roller skating coaching and skating products. - Offering a range of private one-on-one skating training sessions tailored to each customer’s skill level, catering to ages 3 to 65, with most of our clients being teens and kids. - Business has more than 10,000 memberships and about 1,000+ are active, with options for group, private, and VIP sessions, to fit different needs and budgets. - The most popular products include roller skates and safety gear, which are mostly purchased by our learners who want to practice outside of coaching. - Business attracts new customers through social media marketing and by offering free 30-minute trial sessions, which often convert into memberships. - The experienced team includes competitive skaters, and 3 years ago we proudly secured 2nd place at the Roller-Skating Football World Cup in Turkey. - Membership prices range from AED 250 for a single class to AED 900 for five classes, and ten classes for AED 1,800 up to AED 4,500 for a VIP package of 35 classes. - With a solid revenue stream from membership packages and product sales, we’re continuously growing our community of skating enthusiasts in Abu Dhabi and Dubai.
